resources.string: Add or clone a local repository before preparing an Obsidian connection.
Connect Obsidian Git using this repository’s selected GitHub account. Credentials are encrypted for the companion and stay out of callback links.

Use the same device folder as your Obsidian vault. Enable the Git and GitSync.md Connect community plugins in Obsidian. HTTPS GitHub repositories need a connected GitHub account selected in Repository connection. Preparing a connection does not change your files or Git history.
Connection prepared. Open this folder in Obsidian, then run GitSync.md Connect: Connect this vault. A new request replaces any older pending connection.
Encrypted credentials are ready for Obsidian.
Obsidian could not connect. Check folder access, the original GitHub HTTPS remote and the repository’s selected GitHub account, then prepare a new connection.
Connection stopped. No request will replay automatically. Prepare a new connection before retrying in Obsidian.
Obsidian could not be opened. Enable GitSync.md Connect in Obsidian, then try returning again.
Block future credential handoffs for this folder? Credentials already imported into Obsidian remain there. Remove or revoke those separately if needed. Your working copy stays in place.
Future handoffs are disabled. Prepare a new connection to reconnect this folder.
